name: Yazaki Yoshito
source: Class rep for Smell the Roses. Although he served as a cultural festival committee representative in his previous year, he backed down from the problems he faced and has remained quiet since. He’s kind, takes good care of others, and genuinely wants to improve things for everyone, but he doesn’t believe that he can make a difference on his own.
